input.question: Which workflow problem should the next revision address?

evidence.statement: Setup loses the selected device after restart.
The device must be selected again on every launch.
Device selection persisted after restart in this environment.

candidate.answer: Test whether persisting device selection removes repeated setup.

themes.label: Device selection persistence
themes.problemStatement: Some users must repeat device setup after restarting.
themes.workflow: Select a device, restart, and continue the prior task.

conflicts.statement: Persistence behavior differs across observed environments.
conflicts.treatment: Keep the environment dependency unresolved and test multiple configurations.

gaps: The sample does not identify which environment property explains the difference.

nextProbes.hypothesis: Persisting a stable device ref removes repeated setup.
nextProbes.method: Replay restart fixtures across three device configurations.
nextProbes.success: The selected device is restored in all supported fixtures.
nextProbes.failure: Any supported fixture loses or misbinds the selected device.
